reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho Expense and it works well enough. I don't want a second system and a Google Sheet next to it, and a duplicate receipt is something I handle by talking to the foreman, not with another subscription.
objection: It's one more tool on top of the one we already pay for. A duplicate is a people problem, and I don't see what this does that my current app and my bookkeeper don't already cover.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into Zoho or Jurnal from the site Telegram groups, so my bookkeeper stopped chasing receipts in chats and nobody had to retype anything, I'd try it.
